fact_text: Trading on PMEX carries four cost layers: the broker's commission, the exchange fee on trade value, a volume-based processing fee, and an optional capital gains tax on profits.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PMEX Fees & Charges Explained 🔍 | Complete Cost Breakdown | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-05-14)

fact_text: For a gold contract on PMEX, the broker's commission is PKR 25 plus 15% sales tax of PKR 3.75, for a total of PKR 28.75 per contract.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PMEX Fees & Charges Explained 🔍 | Complete Cost Breakdown | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-05-14)

fact_text: The PMEX processing fee follows a volume slab; for trades from PKR 1,000 up to PKR 5 million the fee is PKR 250, as set out in a PMEX circular.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PMEX Fees & Charges Explained 🔍 | Complete Cost Breakdown | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-05-14)

fact_text: The analyst said investors should count every cost layer in their trading cost, because each is charged per trade and the exchange fee moves with the contract's price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PMEX Fees & Charges Explained 🔍 | Complete Cost Breakdown | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-05-14)

fact_text: Pakistan Mercantile Exchange charges a fee of 0.009% of total trade value, on top of the broker's commission.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PMEX Fees & Charges Explained 🔍 | Complete Cost Breakdown | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-05-14)

fact_text: At 0.009% of trade value, the PMEX fee on a PKR 9.5 lakh trade works out to about PKR 85.50 in the analyst's example.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PMEX Fees & Charges Explained 🔍 | Complete Cost Breakdown | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-05-14)

fact_text: Gold's market price was quoted at USD 3,300 in the 14 May 2025 video.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PMEX Fees & Charges Explained 🔍 | Complete Cost Breakdown | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-05-14)

fact_text: The analyst converted dollar trade values into rupees at PKR 280 per USD on 14 May 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PMEX Fees & Charges Explained 🔍 | Complete Cost Breakdown | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-05-14)

fact_text: Capital gains tax on share trading profits is a fixed 5% for both filers and non-filers, so a PKR 1 lakh profit carries PKR 5,000 of tax.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PMEX Fees & Charges Explained 🔍 | Complete Cost Breakdown | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-05-14)
